reason: My bookings already come through Facebook, Instagram, Google Maps and WhatsApp, so I don't see what a website adds. €600 plus €15 every month is real money for something I'm not sure brings even one extra transfer.
objection: €600 is a lot when I don't know if it brings any bookings. People already find me on Maps and message me on WhatsApp, so why pay for another place to show the same prices?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another taxi or boat guy on this coast whose new site actually brought him more WhatsApp bookings, or paying half now and half only after the bookings come.
